greeter.background.description: Full path to the background image for the greeter screen.

greeter.user_icon.description: Full path to the image to use as the user avatar. Leave empty for default.

greeter.hide_userlist.description: If true, hides the user list from the greeter.

greeter.allow_hidden_user.description: If true, allows logging in by typing the username directly.

greeter.theme_name.description: GTK+ theme name to use for the greeter interface.

greeter.icon_theme_name.description: Icon theme name to use for the greeter interface.

greeter.font_name.description: Font family name to use in the greeter.

greeter.locale.description: Locale code (e.g., en_US.UTF-8) for the greeter. Leave empty for system default.

greeter.idle_timeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds before the screensaver starts. 0 means disabled.

greeter.screensaver_command.description: Command to run for the screensaver. Leave empty for default.

greeter.screensaver_locked.description: Whether to lock the screen when the screensaver starts.

greeter.layout_direction.description: Text layout direction: 'ltr' for left-to-right or 'rtl' for right-to-left.

greeter.log.description: If true, enables debug logging for the greeter.
